reward_kinds.box: named Bronze/Silver box (box_name has no tier prefix)
reward_kinds.title: Title only
reward_kinds.hidden: spine plant toast, no reward, never explained

pacing.core_4_5_floors_1_2: 2-4 Bronze and 0-1 Silver per crawler per floor, Welcome Box included; Benefactor extra
pacing.floor_doc_8_2: Floor doc caps achievement boxes at 2 per crawler (plus Welcome Box). Core 4.5 is the winning rule (spec v0.1.1 2.6); box overage is logged in the box ledger with the deed.
pacing.alpha_note: Bone Wifebeater logged 5 achievement Bronze boxes in the alpha (You Better Fucking Listen, Penalty Kick, Warranty Void If Removed, Tow Package, Tick Sandwich); Horn logged 1 (Grease Tube Disposal).
pacing.no_desperado_box: Desperado Pass Tattoo comes in a first Asshole's Box (L-019); there is no Desperado Box.

achievements.title: Don't Skip Intro
achievements.trigger: Sat through Proctor Bell's whole spiel
achievements.description: You listened to the whole tutorial. Like a nerd. A live nerd, for now.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Nothing. Listening was the reward.
achievements.text_status: floor doc §10.1 line; reward line proposed
achievements.notes: R0. Canon snark-only reward pattern. Alpha: given to both crawlers 14:59 CT.

achievements.title: Grease Tube Disposal
achievements.trigger: Killed a Vent Rat with Magic Missile
achievements.description: You sent a rat down the grease tube with a spell. Its cousins are already filing paperwork.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: You've received a Bronze Pest Control, Magical Edition Box!
achievements.text_status: alpha: name and Bronze box logged; description + box name proposed
achievements.notes: Alpha Bronze for Horn (opened later: 50 credits + Driftglobe). Name 'Grease Tube Disposal' is in OT:117.

achievements.title: You Better Fucking Listen
achievements.trigger: First Rage + signature maul kill of a Vent Rat
achievements.description: You hit a rat until it understood. The rat was listening. It just couldn't help itself.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: You've received a Bronze Talked to the Rat With a Hammer Box!
achievements.box_name: Talked to the Rat With a Hammer Box
achievements.text_status: alpha: name and Bronze logged; description + box name proposed
achievements.notes: Signature attack name chosen by the player at intake.

achievements.title: Penalty Kick
achievements.trigger: Punted a burning rat into a wall (unarmed Rage kill)
achievements.description: You punted a burning rat into a wall. The rat did not see it coming. The rat saw nothing.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: You've received a Bronze Field Goal Box!
achievements.notes: Audit R1 sample. Alpha Bronze.

achievements.title: Buddy System
achievements.trigger: Stabilized an ally at 0 HP with a first-aid kit
achievements.description: You saved a teammate. They owe you. Collect before they die.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Title "Buddy System" and 25 credits. Spend them on someone you like.
achievements.text_status: floor doc §10.1 line; reward line audit R2
achievements.notes: R1. Credits-for-Titles is HOUSE. +25 logged in credit-ledger seq 4.

achievements.title: Down But Not Out
achievements.trigger: Stabilized at 0 HP after an Opportunity Attack dropped you
achievements.description: Stabilized! You're alive, technically, which is our favorite kind of alive.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Title "Down But Not Out" and 25 credits. Technically alive pays technically well.
achievements.text_status: floor doc §10.1 line; reward line proposed
achievements.notes: R1. Canon cousin: Survivor's Box (L-011) for barely surviving. +25 logged seq 9.

achievements.title: Personal Luggage
achievements.trigger: Hauled an unconscious ally to the nearest saferoom
achievements.description: You carried your friend like a carry-on. The carry-on has feelings, mostly about airlines.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Title "Personal Luggage" and 25 credits. Excess baggage fee waived. This time.
achievements.notes: R1. +25 logged seq 5.

achievements.title: Warranty Void If Removed
achievements.trigger: Investigated Proctor Bell's mount: ceiling rails, not floor-bolted
achievements.description: You noticed the ceiling rails. Nobody noticed you noticing.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: You've received a Bronze Maintenance Closet Box!
achievements.notes: Alpha Bronze for Bone.

achievements.title: Tow Package
achievements.trigger: Tied self and an unconscious ally to Proctor Bell's booth and got towed Zone 2 to Zone 3
achievements.description: You tied an unconscious friend to a booth and let it drag you both through the building.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: You've received a Bronze Dead Weight Box!
achievements.notes: Alpha Bronze for Bone (Ath 23 check).

achievements.title: Corpse Lesson
achievements.trigger: Looted Tanya Ruiz's body
achievements.description: You went through a dead woman's pockets before learning her name. Efficient. Ghoulish. On-brand.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: A lesson. You may find it in your conscience. Please check.
achievements.text_status: floor doc §10.1 line; reward line proposed
achievements.notes: R0 snark only.

achievements.title: Find a Lore Scrap
achievements.trigger: Found Tanya's handwritten note
achievements.description: You found a dead woman's diary. Reading it is free. Living with it costs extra.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Title "Find a Lore Scrap" and 25 credits. Some of that is hazard pay.
achievements.text_status: floor doc §10.1 line; reward line proposed
achievements.notes: R1. +25 logged seq 7. Reading it aloud is a separate achievement below.

achievements.title: Vending Gore
achievements.trigger: Robbed a Snakk-Matic machine that bites (Nat 20 smash)
achievements.description: You robbed a machine that bites. The machine respects you. Nobody else does.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Title "Vending Gore" and 25 credits. Try not to spend it all at the machine.
achievements.text_status: floor doc §10.1 line; reward line proposed
achievements.notes: R1. +25 logged seq 8. Fan tobacco pull also fired at this beat (house shortcut).

achievements.title: Tick Sandwich
achievements.trigger: Peeled two Ceiling Ticks off your body and clapped them together
achievements.description: You peeled two parasites off your own body and clapped them together. Disgusting. Ratings up.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: You've received a Bronze That-Was-Disgusting Box!
achievements.notes: Box name is a canon type (L-B66, WIKI-ONLY). Alpha Bronze; with this Bone logged 5 achievement Bronze, over the 2-4 band that includes the Welcome Box (core §4.5).

achievements.title: Mostly Dead Intern
achievements.trigger: Floor 1 Reprieve used: ejected to the Break Room at 1 HP
achievements.description: You are not dead. You are an intern. Both are temporary.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Title "Mostly Dead Intern". It comes with a lanyard.
achievements.notes: Mocks the Reprieve, not the death (audit O24). No credits.

achievements.title: Participation Corpse
achievements.trigger: Floor 1 Reprieve used: ejected to the Break Room at 1 HP
achievements.description: You died on time and attended regardless. The certificate is in the mail.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Title "Participation Corpse". Nobody else gets a ribbon.
achievements.notes: Title only. Reprieve Titles listed in floor doc §1.3.

achievements.title: Coin Slot
achievements.trigger: Pay Proctor Bell before it finishes its intro
achievements.description: You paid the robot to stop talking. Relatable. Didn't work.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: One credit's worth of silence, redeemable never.

achievements.title: Assault on Faculty
achievements.trigger: Attack Proctor Bell
achievements.description: You punched the teacher. The teacher is glass. The glass is fine. Your hand isn't.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: A tutorial on pain.
achievements.notes: R0. Proctor Bell is an object, 40 HP, not a combatant.

achievements.title: First Blood
achievements.trigger: First kill of the floor
achievements.description: First kill! It was a rat. Your parents would be so... it was a rat.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Title "Blooded" and one flask of oil. Do not drink it.
achievements.notes: R1. Canon first-kill achievement (A-149, M-001) is the base; reward here is HOUSE.

achievements.title: Land a Critical Hit
achievements.trigger: Roll a natural 20 on an attack
achievements.description: Natural 20. Don't let it go to your head. Your head has enough going on.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Nothing. The crit was the reward. Think about that.

achievements.title: Scenic Panic
achievements.trigger: Panic loudly in chat, then win
achievements.description: You typed 'WE'RE GONNA DIE' in all caps and then won. We heard you scream. In text.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Your screams, preserved for a bloopers reel.

achievements.title: Fed the Machine
achievements.trigger: Bitten by a Hungry Vendor
achievements.description: You put your hand in a hole with teeth. Your mother would be proud. Of the machine.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: A bandage. Pay for it.

achievements.title: Hidden Cache
achievements.trigger: Find the DC 15 back cage (3b)
achievements.description: You looked behind the machine. Nobody looks behind the machine.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Title "Hidden Cache" and 25 credits. Nobody ever looks. Good for you.

achievements.title: Side Path
achievements.trigger: Reveal the Service Corridor (Zone S) via the 3b map
achievements.description: You found the staff-only route. Staff are required to hate you.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Title "Side Path" and 25 credits. Keep taking the side paths. We love watching.

achievements.title: Read a Lore Scrap Aloud
achievements.trigger: Read Tanya's note out loud to the party
achievements.description: You read a dead woman's last words to a room full of cameras. Beautiful. Or content. It's content.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Heroic Inspiration, if you meant it. A shrug, if you didn't.
achievements.notes: R2 if heartfelt; R0 if mocking. Heroic Inspiration max 1 per session (core §3.7). Catalog rarity outlier stepped down.

achievements.title: Odd Coin Pocketed
achievements.trigger: Open the UNCLAIMED crate in the Lost & Found
achievements.description: Oddity logged.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: (none)
achievements.notes: HIDDEN, no reward. Spine plant SEED-ODDCOIN. Never explain. GM (2026-10-07): an identify/appraise request to any terminal, vendor or the System gets ITEM NOT RECOGNIZED (or the cancelled 500-credit offer); never name a floor, fee, clearance level or future appraisal.

achievements.title: Rescue a Civilian
achievements.trigger: Get Dale Pruitt out of the net
achievements.description: You saved Dale. Dale will now talk to you about ductwork. Forever. You did this.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Title "Lifeguard" and 25 credits. Dale says thanks. Dale says it again.

achievements.title: Fail to Rescue a Civilian
achievements.trigger: Dale dies
achievements.description: Dale's dead. The audience is sad. Sad audiences buy merch. So... thanks?
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Merch sales are up. You receive none of it.
achievements.notes: R0 (tasteless to pay 25). Run the permanence popup.

achievements.title: Poison Tolerant
achievements.trigger: Poisoned, then cured
achievements.description: You got stuck by a dirty needle and lived. Very public-restroom of you.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Title "Poison Tolerant" and 25 credits. Wash your hands.

achievements.title: Disarm a Trap with Junk
achievements.trigger: Disarm a trap using gum, shoes or similar junk
achievements.description: You beat a trap with chewing gum. MacGyver's crying. So is the trap.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Title "Gum Disarmer" and 25 credits. Chew on that.

achievements.title: Literacy Optional
achievements.trigger: Trigger a trap the signs warned about
achievements.description: Three signs. You read zero. Who raised you? Don't answer. We'll find her.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: A fourth sign. Read it.
achievements.notes: R0. If box-worthy: Bronze Maybe Read the Sign Next Time Box (core §4.8 #5), but only inside the 2-4 Bronze band.

achievements.title: Block a Hit with a Shield
achievements.trigger: Block an attack with a Shield
achievements.description: You held up a stop sign and it worked. Traffic law remains undefeated.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Title "Crossing Guard" and 25 credits. Please do not run red lights.

achievements.title: Lose Initiative and Still Win
achievements.trigger: Win a fight after going last
achievements.description: You went last and still won. The audience calls this a comeback. We call it luck with confidence.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Title "Last Pick" and 25 credits. Last place pays surprisingly well.

achievements.title: Hit the Cutout
achievements.trigger: Attack a plywood crawler in the Shooting Gallery
achievements.description: That one was plywood. To be fair, it looked smarter than you.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Splinters.

achievements.title: Saferoom Skeptic
achievements.trigger: Search a certified saferoom for traps
achievements.description: You searched a certified saferoom for traps. Clean. You're paranoid. Stay that way.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: A refilled Thieves' Tools kit or Healer's Kit, your pick. Paranoia pays.
achievements.notes: R1 tool refill (no credits).

achievements.title: Share Food with the Party
achievements.trigger: Split a meal with the party
achievements.description: You split a sandwich. With feelings. Gross. Wholesome. Gross.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Title "Meal Buddy" and 25 credits. Do not mention the sandwich.

achievements.title: Rumor Mill
achievements.trigger: Read the Break Room corkboard three times
achievements.description: You read a corkboard. Three times. Somebody get this crawler a library card.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Title "Rumor Mill" and 25 credits. Gossip is a skill.

achievements.title: Lunch Thief
achievements.trigger: Eat Dale's labeled sandwich in front of Dale
achievements.description: Dale saw. Dale will always have seen.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Indigestion. Dale's.

achievements.title: First Box
achievements.trigger: Open the Welcome Box
achievements.description: Your pupils went full slot machine. It's going in the promo.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: The box. You're welcome.
achievements.notes: R0. Welcome Box is the one fixed box name on the floor (floor doc §8.1).

achievements.title: Stair Bait Resisted
achievements.trigger: Walk away from the EXIT without going down
achievements.description: You smelled freedom and said 'nah.' The birds are devastated.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: You've received a Bronze Didn't Fall for the Birdsong Box!
achievements.box_name: Didn't Fall for the Birdsong Box
achievements.notes: Floor doc §10.1 Bronze box; the floor's best smart-play reward.

achievements.title: Freedom Smelled Like a Fan
achievements.trigger: Go down the Big Green EXIT
achievements.description: You heard birds and ran at them like a horny golden retriever. The pit has your name on it now. We engraved it.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: A pit with your name. Also, a bruise.
achievements.notes: R0. Alternate Bronze if the fight goes well: Bronze You Opened the Door Marked 'Do Not' Box (core §4.8 #3).

achievements.title: First Down
achievements.trigger: First time you hit 0 HP
achievements.description: You hit the floor. The floor hit back. Floor: 1. You: also on the floor.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: A tutorial popup, and zero dignity.

achievements.title: Close Call
achievements.trigger: Survive at exactly 1 HP
achievements.description: One hit point. One. We could have framed it, but you asked to keep it.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Title "Close Call" and 25 credits. Go buy a potion.
achievements.notes: R1. Canon cousin: Survivor's Box (L-011).

achievements.title: Sacrifice Play
achievements.trigger: Take a hit meant for someone else
achievements.description: You took the hit for someone else. Heroic. Stupid. The good kind of stupid.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: You've received a Bronze Took One for the Team Box!
achievements.box_name: Took One for the Team Box
achievements.notes: Floor doc §10.1 Bronze box.

achievements.title: Tutorial Elite
achievements.trigger: Defeat Bruiser the Mascot (Unoccupied)
achievements.description: You beat up an empty costume. Nobody was inside. Think about that. Then don't.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Title "Mascot Hunter" and 25 credits. The costume's bleeding stuffing.

achievements.title: Static in the Ear
achievements.trigger: First death save on Floor 1 (Benefactor Signal)
achievements.description: Signal logged.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: (none)
achievements.notes: HIDDEN, no reward. Spine plant SEED-BENEFACTOR. If asked: 'No such broadcast exists.'

achievements.title: Level-Up, Baby!
achievements.trigger: Reach level 2 at the Green Room
achievements.description: Level two. The audience noticed you are slightly less bad.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: More hit points. And your own self-respect, we hear it's back in stock.
achievements.notes: Canon achievement A-070 (reaching level 2, reward None, VERIFIED B1 ch5); wording here is original, reward is snark-only like canon.

achievements.title: Stair Seeker
achievements.trigger: Find the service stairwell before beating the boss
achievements.description: You found the back stairs before the boss. Smart. Cowardly. Smart.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: You've received a Bronze Went Around the Bouncer Box!
achievements.notes: Floor doc §10.1 Bronze box.

achievements.title: Dodge a Telegraphed AoE
achievements.trigger: Avoid a telegraphed area attack from Dean Thudd
achievements.description: He counted to three. You can count to three. Congratulations on counting to three.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Title "Counted to Three" and 25 credits. Count higher next time.

achievements.title: Boss Babe
achievements.trigger: Deal damage to Dean Thudd
achievements.description: You hit the dean. The dean noticed. The dean has a club.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Nothing. Punching a boss is its own reward, apparently.
achievements.notes: Canon achievement A-011 (dealing damage to a boss, reward None, VERIFIED B1 ch11); wording original.

achievements.title: Peaceful Path
achievements.trigger: Talk Dean Thudd into early retirement
achievements.description: You talked the Dean into retirement. HR is furious. We are HR.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: You've received a Bronze Talked the Final Exam Into Early Retirement Box!
achievements.box_name: Talked the Final Exam Into Early Retirement Box
achievements.notes: Floor doc §10.1 Bronze box (in addition to Silver Boss Box? fold per ACH-0170 notes).

achievements.title: Environmentalist
achievements.trigger: Kill Dean Thudd using the orchestra pit
achievements.description: You killed him with an orchestra pit. The orchestra has filed a complaint.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: You've received a Bronze Pit Stop Box!
achievements.notes: Floor doc §10.1 Bronze box.

achievements.title: Boss Claim
achievements.trigger: Defeat or talk down Dean Thudd
achievements.description: The Dean is down. The dean is unavailable for comment. The dean is on the floor.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: You've received a Silver Pushed the Dean Into the Orchestra Pit and Called It Extra Credit Box!
achievements.box_name: Pushed the Dean Into the Orchestra Pit and Called It Extra Credit Box
achievements.notes: FOLDED into the Silver Boss Box (floor doc §6.7). Boss Box capped to Silver by F1 ceiling (core §4.7). Counts as the crawler's single 0-1 Silver. Alt names in floor doc §6.7: Accepted a Diploma..., Talked the Final Exam..., Dodged the Group Photo....

achievements.title: Most Dangerous Hug
achievements.trigger: Accept Dean Thudd's diploma mid-fight
achievements.description: You let an ogre hug you for ratings. Your spine and the audience both screamed.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Crowd Pop and a rib check. Both are free.
achievements.notes: R2 (Crowd Pop) per floor doc §10.2. Heroic Inspiration max 1 per session.

achievements.title: Destroy a Camera or Drone
achievements.trigger: Destroy a camera or the drone
achievements.description: You broke a camera. We have eleven thousand more. That one was Kevin's favorite, though.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: A very small fine, billed to Kevin.

achievements.title: Skipped Finals
achievements.trigger: Bypass Dean Thudd via the service stairs
achievements.description: You went around the final exam, through the janitor's door, like a raccoon. Four million viewers just watched.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: A raccoon sticker. No Boss Box. No Boss Claim.
achievements.notes: R0. Bypass loses the Boss Box (floor doc §7.2); Stair Seeker can still pay.

achievements.title: Tutorial Complete
achievements.trigger: Descend the Floor 1 stairwell
achievements.description: You graduated. Your diploma is in the mail. The mail is on fire.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Title "Oriented". It is not a compliment.
achievements.notes: R1 Title only (ACH-0076 retired duplicate). Fires once.

achievements.title: Strategic Advance in the Other Direction
achievements.trigger: Flee a fight without taking damage
achievements.description: REWARD! ... lol no. Bitches don't get rewards.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: ...lol no.
achievements.notes: R0. Canon snark-only pattern; line adapted from floor doc §10.2.

achievements.title: Toe Talent
achievements.trigger: Fight barefoot, kick something to death, or otherwise make it about feet
achievements.description: Our foot demographic would like to thank you personally. Please don't let them.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Attention. Of a kind.
achievements.notes: R0 (R1 if the audience demands it). Foot bit: at most once per session (floor doc §3.2). Respect opt-outs.

achievements.title: Again? Production Has Seen This Episode
achievements.trigger: Repeat a farmed stunt (e.g. vending after the cap)
achievements.description: Reruns don't pay. Ask any actor.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: A rerun.

achievements.title: Bleed Tax
achievements.trigger: Use a third healing item on the tutorial floor
achievements.description: Three healing items on the tutorial floor. You're not a crawler, you're a sponge with a debit card.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: A receipt.

achievements.title: Deal Psychic Damage
achievements.trigger: Deal psychic damage
achievements.description: You hurt its feelings. Literally. We're so proud. Of the feelings.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: An apology to the feelings.

achievements.title: Trailblazing Vending Gore
achievements.trigger: First crawler in the campaign to smash a Snakk-Matic machine open
achievements.description: You are the first crawler to murder a snack machine this season. Management is thrilled.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: You've received a Silver Snakk-Matic Box!
achievements.notes: Trailblazing pattern (audit R8; canon Crazy Cat Lady -> Trailblazing Crazy Cat Lady A-024/A-114, WIKI-ONLY for A-114): same theme, one tier up, Silver max on F1. DESIGN ONLY: in the alpha Bone was first and was paid only base Vending Gore; do not backfill. Counts as the crawler's 0-1 Silver, so do not also pay a Boss Box Silver unless the table agrees.

achievements.title: Paperwork Survivor
achievements.trigger: Complete intake
achievements.description: You completed intake without dying, crying, or reading the Terms of Service. Two out of three ain't bad.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: ...No. It's paperwork. Nobody gets a prize for paperwork.
achievements.text_status: toast text from character creation guide §9; floor doc §10.2 NEW R0
achievements.notes: R0 snark-only, pays nothing. Intake toast (create flow step 7); fires once per Crawler at intake. Given to all three s1 Crawlers.

achievements.title: Win Initiative
achievements.trigger: Win initiative on the floor's first roll
achievements.description: You went first. Enjoy it. It is the last time anything down here waits for you.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: None. Bragging rights only.
achievements.text_status: trigger from floor doc day-01 Z2 hooks; description proposed; reward line as played in s1
achievements.notes: Catalog R1 downgraded to R0 on F1 (floor doc §5.2 seeds: too routine to pay). Catalog name 'Orientation Pit: Win initiative'. s1: Mr. White, Vent Row.

achievements.title: Rescued by Paperwork
achievements.trigger: Floor 1 Reprieve used: ejected to the nearest saferoom at 1 HP
achievements.description: You were, for legal reasons, not dead. Please do not take this as a precedent.
achievements.reward_line: Reward: Title "Rescued by Paperwork". No credits. No precedent.
achievements.text_status: Title and toast from floor doc §1.3 (Reprieve)
achievements.notes: Title only, no credits (same as Mostly Dead Intern / Participation Corpse). Third suggested Reprieve Title in floor doc §1.3; pick one Reprieve Title per Reprieve. s1: Mr. White, 2026-10-07.
